dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good morning, customer relations. This is Karen. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ˈkʌstəmər rɪˈleɪʃənz. ðɪs ɪz ˈkærən. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'm calling about a hotel I booked on your website. It wasn't as described.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ə hoʊˈtɛl aɪ ˈbʊkt ɑːn jʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt. ɪt ˈwʌzənt əz dɪˈskraɪbd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What was the problem?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈhɪr ˈðæt. ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈprɑːbləm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was told that my room had a sea view. But from my window, I could only see a parking lot.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈtoʊld ðæt maɪ ˈruːm ˈhæd ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː. bʌt frəm maɪ ˈwɪndoʊ, aɪ kʊd ˈoʊnli ˈsiː ə ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˌlɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I see. What does the description on our website say?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈwʌt dʌz ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən ɑːn aʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It states that every room has a sea view. That's false.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈsteɪts ðæt ˈɛvri ˈruːm ˈhæz ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː. ðæts ˈfɔːls.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I was promised free breakfast, but I had to pay for it. I was also told that the beach was five minutes away. It was thirty minutes by car!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ wʌz ˈprɑːmɪst ˈfriː ˈbrɛkfəst, bʌt aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈpeɪ fər ɪt. aɪ wʌz ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈtoʊld ðæt ðə ˈbiːtʃ wʌz ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts əˈweɪ. ɪt wʌz ˈθɜːrti ˈmɪnɪts baɪ ˈkɑːr!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry. I'm afraid the hotels write their own descriptions.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri. aɪm əˈfreɪd ðə hoʊˈtɛlz ˈraɪt ðɛr ˈoʊn dɪˈskrɪpʃənz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But you put them on your website. A misleading description like that isn't fair to customers.
dialogue.reading: bʌt juː ˈpʊt ðɛm ɑːn jʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt. ə ˌmɪsˈliːdɪŋ dɪˈskrɪpʃən ˈlaɪk ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈfɛr tə ˈkʌstəmərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You're right. Could you send us your booking information by email? Our manager will look at it.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. kʊd juː ˈsɛnd ʌs jʊr ˈbʊkɪŋ ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən baɪ ˈiːmeɪl? aʊr ˈmænɪdʒər wɪl ˈlʊk ət ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll send it this afternoon.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈsɛnd ɪt ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn.
